project.name: ai-proxy
project.summary: A local proxy that detects the LLM provider dialect of an inbound request, forwards it to that provider's upstream, and passes other local traffic through.
project.domain: Gives AI coding agents one local endpoint to point at: the proxy decides which provider the request belongs to, relays it with the caller's own credential, and carries other agent traffic (an MCP server such as ai-raccoon) to its own upstream without altering it.

personaRouting.work: code review, quality gates, PR review
C#/.NET implementation, MCP tools, backend work
